methods.rates_unit: intersection per MEV (TSS 2015-2017 p. 4); statewide per 100M VMT only; no facility-type averages (not found)

crash_costs.note: DC prints none; it uses FHWA published rates (TSS p. 5). FHWA Oct 2025 comprehensive, 2024 $: K 15,988,000; A 1,705,100; B 384,000; C 204,600; O 18,100

methods.screening_method: Ranked lists: frequency, rate (MEV), severity cost, delta trend; Composite Crash Index = 0.25 rank freq + 0.25 rank rate + 0.50 rank severity (TSS p. 5; HSIP 2025 p. 6, 10); TSI 2.0 score on 3 years (HSIP 2025 p. 18); HSM predictive SPF+CMF for HSIP intersections (p. 18); 'critical rate' named for the signs program, formula not given (p. 16)
differences_from_ca: No published average crash rates by facility type (no TASAS base-rate equivalent); compare within DC
Screening is a weighted rank composite (CCI 25/25/50) plus TSI 2.0, not a rate-vs-average or LRSM B/C test
Crash costs are FHWA national, not Caltrans LRSM Appendix D
3 years of crashes (TSI 2.0, CCI), not LRSM's 5
HSM predictive method (SPF+CMF) formally used for HSIP intersections; no DC calibration factors published
Development CTR studies have had no crash analysis since 2022 (qualitative only)
Public severity merges KABCO B and C
